original_text:
What’s the smartest way to speed up your queries in Databricks?

In this video, we break down all the indexing options you need to know — from classic Partitioning to Z-Ordering, and the latest powerhouse: Liquid Clustering.

🔍 We’ll explore:

How Partitioning works — and when it breaks.

What Z-Order sorting does right — and where it falls short.

Why Liquid Clustering is redefining indexing with smarter, real-time data layout.

You'll learn about:


Limitations of each technique
Deletion vector, row tracking & how row level concurrency is achieved using Liquid Clustering powered by row tracking and deletion vectors 

And finally — why Liquid Clustering might be your best bet for scale.

Whether you're a data engineer, architect, or just Databricks-curious — this is the ultimate guide to choosing the right indexing strategy.
